title: Computer vision and speech tasks
hook: Classification, detection, segmentation, OCR, and speech tasks. Name the task before choosing the model.
inPlainWords: Vision and speech are families of tasks, not one thing. Naming the exact task tells you what to label and which model to use.

useCase.title: Turn photos and voice notes into ticket details
useCase.story: Customers send a photo of a damaged parcel, a photo of a receipt, and a voice note describing the problem. ShopEase wants to know: is it damaged, where, what does the receipt say, and what did the customer say?

approaches.name: Image classification
approaches.what: Give the whole image one label.
approaches.greatWhen: A yes or no question, like damaged or not.

approaches.name: Object detection
approaches.what: Find objects and draw boxes around them.
approaches.example: A box around the dented corner.

approaches.name: Segmentation
approaches.what: Label every pixel by what it belongs to.
approaches.example: Outline the crushed area to estimate its size.

approaches.name: OCR and document reading
approaches.what: Read printed or handwritten text and layout.
approaches.example: Read the total from a receipt.

approaches.name: Speech to text
approaches.avoidWhen: Very noisy audio that no one checks.

approaches.name: Other speech tasks
approaches.what: Detect the language, tell speakers apart, or generate speech.
approaches.avoidWhen: Cloning a real person's voice without consent.
approaches.example: Detect that a voice note is in Hindi.

approaches.name: Multimodal model
approaches.what: One model reads image, text and audio together.

challenge.question: ShopEase needs to know where a parcel is damaged and roughly how badly. Which task?

options.text: Detection to find the damage, and segmentation to size it
options.why: Location and size are exactly what those tasks give.
It only says damaged or not damaged, with no location.
OCR reads text. It does not judge damage.
That is for audio, not photos.

bestCase.title: Name the exact task, then pick tools per task
bestCase.example: Detection boxes the dent, segmentation measures how big it is, OCR reads the receipt, and speech to text transcribes the voice note. The results merge into one ticket, and low-confidence items go to a person.

worstCase.title: One general model for everything, unchecked
worstCase.example: A single general model is asked to do all four jobs from a blurry photo and a noisy voice note. It misreads the receipt total and hears "not broken" as "now broken". The ticket is wrong and nobody notices.

route.travelling: A damaged-parcel photo, a receipt photo and a voice note

steps.label: Split by task
steps.goes: Each file is sent to the right task.
steps.goesWrong: Everything goes to one general model in a single step.

steps.label: Vision: detect and size
steps.goes: Detection finds the dent and segmentation sizes it.

steps.label: OCR reads the receipt
steps.goes: The total and date are extracted.

steps.label: Merge and check confidence
steps.goes: Results are combined. Low confidence goes to a person.

takeaway: Name the exact vision or speech task first. It decides the labels, the model and the checks.
